## Standing operator rules
- Run “Monthly payroll run 2025-03” separately between other work, completing its eight ordered steps one at a time.
- Split work into separate branches whenever a change set contains more than one Jira ticket, even if the tickets share a release train.
- Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.
- Never edit `grafana/ledgerly-billing-v3.json` without first posting the proposed dashboard change in `#obs-dashboard` for `@mina` to review.
- Disabling idempotency middleware is not an option; it produced duplicate invoices in staging.
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Fix refund double-counting in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`; tenacity refactor stopped and deferred to next sprint.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Sandbox is `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `sbx-pay-a` is superseded and shut down. Payroll: `payroll-2025-03`, `2025-03`, USD, v3, `batch-20250328-1842`, `$986442.17`.

## Plan and progress
- [pending] Diagnose and fix reconciliation refund counting; next command not specified.
- [status unknown] Full-suite scheduler failure.

## Recent work
Request-ID logging and settings-source logging were added. Exact outputs: logging tests passed; full suite `142 passed, 3 skipped, 1 failed`. Health expectation was fixed and its 4 tests passed. Scheduler tests: `7 passed, 1 failed`; DST recurrence is under investigation.
